title: Counting the Payment Day in Delay Interest on an Entrance Fee Agreement Refund
content:
For delay interest on a late **Entrance Fee Agreement** refund, the interest days counted include the payment day for an estate whose letters arrived after the due date; for a refund payable to the resident the first day is not counted; otherwise the interest days count as they run.

## Inclusion table

| Payee and letters | Interest days counted |
|---|---|
| Estate, letters testamentary or of administration received after the refund due date | The interest days run, plus 1 for the payment day |
| Resident | The interest days run, less 1 for the first day, never below 0 |
| Estate, letters received on or before the due date | The interest days run |

The payee is the refund payee recorded on the agreement, and the letters date is the estate documents date on the agreement.

## Hypothetical counts

| Payee | Letters | Interest days run | Interest days counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Estate | 31 days after the due date | 29 | 30 |
| Resident | Not applicable | 30 | 29 |
| Resident | Not applicable | 0 | 0 |
| Estate | Before the due date | 30 | 30 |
